title: Tools, computers and items you use for work

sections.heading: Tools, computers and items you use for work
sections.text:
Deductions for tools, computers, internet, stationery, books and other items you use for work.

Deductions for tools or instruments you use for work, including the cost of repairs and insurance.

Deductions for mobile phone calls and internet expenses you incur for a work-related purpose, including the device.

Deductions for computers, laptops and software you use for work, including the cost of repairs.

Deductions for work-related home phone, internet and other online services expenses.

Deductions for bags, cases, luggage, lunch boxes and travel mugs you use for work.

Deductions for stationery and supplies such as pens, printer ink, and paper you use for work.

Deductions for equipment or furniture, such as a desk or chair you use for work, including repairs.

Deductions for books, journals, periodicals, digital information, newspapers and magazines you use for work.

Deductions for interest and transaction fee expenses, you incur on items you buy for work.

As an employee, find out how to claim for your depreciating assets and work out decline in value.
